title: Ploughman's Cheese and Pickle Delight
description: A classic British snack featuring a delightful combination of cheese, pickles, and fresh vegetables.
instructions: 1. Arrange the tasty crackers on a large platter or individual plates.
2. Cut the Cheddar cheese into bite-sized pieces and place on top of the crackers.
3. Arrange the pickled cucumbers and ploughman's pickle on the platter.
4. Add fresh lettuce leaves to the platter and sprinkle with flaky sea salt.
5. Garnish with fresh parsley for a pop of color and freshness.
7. If desired, add additional pickles or cheese to the platter for extra flavor.
8. Consider adding other items to the platter, such as grapes or figs, for added variety.
9. For a more substantial snack, consider adding sliced meats or cured fish.
10. Experiment with different types of cheese and pickles to find your favorite combination.
